description: Authoritative declarative rules for validating EQRMSS planner plan-state transitions. This file defines legal state transitions and authorization boundaries; it does not itself mutate current-plan.json.

DRAFT.description: A plan is being constructed or revised and is not yet eligible for execution.

READY.description: A frozen plan has passed planning gates but has not been authorized for execution.

AUTHORIZED.description: One or more explicitly authorized tasks may proceed, subject to exact task identity, dependencies, scope, and validation requirements.

EXECUTING.description: An explicitly authorized task is currently being implemented.

VALIDATING.description: Implementation has been handed off for validation and completion has not yet been established.

COMPLETE.description: The authorized task has been implemented and all required validation conditions have passed.

SUPERSEDED.description: The plan is no longer authoritative because a materially changed plan has replaced it.

requires: plan.status == READY
authorization.status == NOT_AUTHORIZED
authorization.scope contains at least one task ID
every authorized task ID exists in plan.tasks
authorized task definitions match the current plan revision
authorized scope does not include tasks outside the requested scope
no task definition is modified as part of authorization
forbids: expanding authorization beyond the requested scope

requires: authorization.status == AUTHORIZED
execution task ID exists in authorization.scope
execution task ID exists in plan.tasks
task identity matches exactly
task definition matches the frozen plan
all task dependencies are satisfied
no material plan change has occurred
worker handoff contains the exact plan ID
worker handoff contains the exact plan version
worker handoff contains the exact task ID
forbids: inferring a task from repository search

requires: the executing task ID is recorded
implementation output exists
implementation remained within authorized scope
no material plan change occurred during execution
validation has completed
every required validation check for the task has passed
implementation matches the authorized task objective
implementation remained within task scope
no non-scope requirement was violated
the validated task ID exactly matches the executing task ID
the plan has not been superseded
forbids: completion based solely on worker claims
completion based solely on file existence
completion when any required validation check failed

requires: at least one required validation check failed
the task remains authorized
the task identity remains unchanged
an explicit authorization revocation request exists
no task is currently executing
forbids: revoking an executing task through this transition

requires: a materially changed plan exists
the replacement plan has a new plan version or plan ID
the replacement plan records the reason for supersession
forbids: continuing execution under the superseded plan
transferring authorization automatically to the replacement plan

materialChangeRules.description: Any change affecting these properties invalidates existing execution authorization and requires replanning followed by new authorization.

rules.rule: User intent to authorize is not itself persisted authorization.
Authorization is valid only after current-plan.json contains the requested authorized scope.
Planner must reread current-plan.json after authorization persistence before worker handoff.
A task may execute only if its exact task ID is present in authorization.scope.
Authorization cannot implicitly include dependencies unless those dependencies are explicitly authorized.
Authorization cannot alter the task definition.
Authorization cannot be inferred from a previous conversation turn when authoritative state disagrees.
If authoritative state cannot be read or validated, execution is blocked.

invariants.name: Authorization Persistence Invariant
invariants.rule: No authorization is considered successful until current-plan.json has been persisted and reread with the requested authorized scope.

invariants.name: Exact Task Identity
invariants.rule: A task may execute only when its exact identity matches the authoritative plan.

invariants.name: No Context Substitution
invariants.rule: Repository contents, conversation history, search results, or model inference may not replace an authoritative task definition.

invariants.name: No Implicit Scope Expansion
invariants.rule: Authorization for one task does not authorize another task, dependency, or related implementation.

invariants.name: Planner Non-Implementation
invariants.rule: The Planner may plan and hand off authorized work but may not directly implement repository changes.

invariants.name: Validation Before Completion
invariants.rule: A task cannot become COMPLETE until every required validation check passes.

invariants.name: Material Change Invalidates Authorization
invariants.rule: A material change to the frozen plan invalidates existing execution authorization and requires a new authorization.

invariants.name: Superseded Plans Cannot Execute
invariants.rule: A SUPERSEDED plan has no execution authority.

invariants.name: Canonical State Wins
invariants.rule: When conversational state, agent memory, repository inference, and current-plan.json disagree, current-plan.json is authoritative.
